queryLines:
SELECT
    symbol,
    metrics,
    -- MAX(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-09-30' THEN value END) AS Q3_2024,
    MAX(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN '2024-10-01' AND '2024-12-31' THEN value END) AS Q4_2024,
    MAX(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31' THEN value END) AS Q1_2025,
    MAX(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-06-30' THEN value END) AS Q2_2025,

    MAX(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31' THEN value END) AS Q4_2025
FROM yfinance_pipeline_prod.stocks_dataset.balance_sheet
-- where symbol = "AMZN"
GROUP BY symbol, metrics
-- ORDER BY symbol, metrics;
